title: The Federal Budget Pie
prompt: You are the President. Allocate exactly 100% of the tax revenue. Balance baseline national security with public infrastructure investments.
success_text: Success! You maintained baseline security while investing heavily in future human capital. Long-term GDP projections look strong.
fail_text: Failure. Your allocation triggered civic unrest due to social cuts, or underfunded research completely tanked innovation.

title: Cool Down Inflation
prompt: Inflation is raging at 8.5%. Adjust the central bank's benchmark interest rate to bring inflation down to the 2% target without triggering a massive recession.
success_text: Perfect! Raising the interest rate to between 5.5% and 7.0% cooled down consumer borrowing just enough to tame inflation without massive layoffs.
fail_text: Unsuccessful. Keeping rates too low allowed runaway hyperinflation to destroy savings. Moving them too high instantly triggered a severe economic depression.
